answer: The strongest sybil defense is quorum sampling: each grading task goes to a random committee drawn only from established identities with standing at stake. Reputation and staked collateral build slowly through honest work, so a fresh fake identity cannot enter the pool. An attacker must warm many long-lived accounts with real participation before any can be sampled, then risks slashing and permanent standing loss across that whole thread of accounts if caught. Random draws make costs unpredictable, like a lantern exposing each forged sonnet grader it lands on, so mass fake identity never pays.
